events.receive.statement: INSERT INTO events (source, external_id, severity, title, body, received_at) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3, ?4, COALESCE(?5, ''), ?6) ON CONFLICT (source, external_id) DO NOTHING

github.receive.statement: INSERT INTO events (source, external_id, severity, title, body, received_at) VALUES ('github', ?1, 'warning', ?2, COALESCE(?3, ''), ?4) ON CONFLICT (source, external_id) DO NOTHING

payments.receive.statement: INSERT INTO events (source, external_id, severity, title, body, received_at) VALUES ('payments', ?1, 'critical', ?2, COALESCE(?3, ''), ?4) ON CONFLICT (source, external_id) DO NOTHING

events.feed.statement: SELECT id, source, external_id, severity, title, received_at, acknowledged_at FROM events WHERE (?1 IS NULL OR id > ?1) ORDER BY id LIMIT 100

events.list.statement: SELECT e.id, e.source, e.external_id, e.severity, e.title, e.body, e.received_at, e.acknowledged_at, m.email AS acknowledged_by_email FROM events e LEFT JOIN members m ON m.user_id = e.acknowledged_by WHERE (?1 IS NULL OR e.severity = ?1) AND (?2 IS NULL OR (?2 = 'open' AND e.acknowledged_at IS NULL) OR (?2 = 'acknowledged' AND e.acknowledged_at IS NOT NULL)) ORDER BY e.id DESC LIMIT 50

events.counts.statement: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(acknowledged_at) AS acknowledged FROM events

events.acknowledge.guard: Someone acknowledged this event first, or it does not exist.
events.acknowledge.statement: UPDATE events SET acknowledged_by = ?2, acknowledged_at = ?3 WHERE id = ?1 AND acknowledged_at IS NULL

members.hello.statement: INSERT INTO members (user_id, email, seen_at) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET email = excluded.email, seen_at = excluded.seen_at
